    BigHashMap<K,V>

    BigNumberedMap<K extends edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered, V>

    class 
    NodeHashMap<V>
    A hash map that uses nodes as keys, where two nodes are considered the same if their states are the same and, for each character, the beliefs of that character lead to nodes which are the same.
    class 
    PlanHashMap<V>
    A hash map that uses plans as keys, where two plans are considered the same if they represent the same sequence of actions.
    class 
    StateHashMap<V>
    A hash map that uses states as keys, where two states are considered the same if they return the same values for all fluents and return the same utility values for all characters.
    class 
    StateMapping
    A hash map that maps state graph nodes to their corresponding story graph state objects.
